What we'll need from you before pickup:

- Packing list that shows the printed playbooks (40 copies) and demo unit serials

Appreciate a quick confirmation and ETA.

Elena — thanks, noted. We can meet the morning window and will send the customs paperwork before pickup. Summary of plan:

1) Shipping method: FastFreight (Marco Ruiz) for door-to-door clearance — ETA for delivery to Main loading dock A: Dec 1, 08:30–11:00 local. Carrier will require a contact number for Daniel (please confirm).

2) Customs paperwork: attached commercial invoice and packing list (see attachments). We will include HS codes and declare the batteries as external, <100Wh each. If you prefer an ATA carnet to avoid VAT/ duties, let us know — we can arrange but it will add processing time.

3) Onsite handling: carrier will require an on-site signature and photo of the delivery. If Global Retail prefers a nominated concierge, we can coordinate that with Daniel.

4) Backup: Ben will airport-handcarry a configuration kit if the courier encounters any delay — Ben, can you confirm flight/package plan?

I attached: packing_list_briefcases_v3.pdf, commercial_invoice_RWD-7892.pdf, customs_declaration_batteries.pdf.

If okay, we'll schedule pickup tonight (Nov 30) for next-morning arrival. Please confirm Daniel's number and whether you want Redwood to engage the customs broker (we recommend Carlos Mejia at Clearance Co. for quick turnarounds).

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
